timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Australian Hearing Implant Maker, Cochlear and Google's Research Division,
Google AI, have formed a coalition aimed at researching ways to improve hearing technology.
The partnership will seek to leverage Google's artificial intelligence and machine learning
expertise to develop better algorithms for costler's implants, which currently help users hear
sounds and speech more clearly. Cochlear and Google AI will also focus on ways to better preserve
and protect users' residual hearing, which can deteriorate over time with continued implant use.
The collaboration aims to create a more personalized hearing experience for users,
with the use of machine learning algorithms, potentially allowing the implant to adapt to an
individual's changing hearing abilities over time. The partnership is expected to lead to the
development of more advanced hearing devices that offer improved sound quality and other
benefits to users. Cochlear and Google AI's joint efforts could ultimately have a significant
impact on the millions of people worldwide who experience hearing loss.

Gain insights into the latest research and advancements in the field and learn how AI is helping to create a more inclusive and accessible world.
